import os,json,sys
d=os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR']
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read()
import re
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']
# find objects
seen=set(); objs=[]
for i in range(10):
    for j in range(10):
        if inp[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
            c=inp[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                if (a,b) in seen or inp[a][b]!=c: continue
                seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                st+= [(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
            objs.append((c,comp))
for c,comp in objs:
    rs=[a for a,b in comp]; cs=[b for a,b in comp]
    print(c,'h',max(rs)-min(rs)+1,'w',max(cs)-min(cs)+1,'top',min(rs),min(cs),'n',len(comp))

    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); objs=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; comp=set()
                while st:
